## 6. ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS

### Why is the schema out of sync?

| Cause | Details |
|-------|---------|
| Never-run migrations | 15 tables defined in migrations between 2026_04_27 and 2026_06_15 were never applied to production |
| Partial P0 fix | fix_schema.php added some approval columns but missed 20 task columns and all 15 missing tables |
| No automated migration | deploy.php does git reset --hard but does not run migrate.php |
| No schema gate | No pre-deploy check blocks deployment when schema is out of sync |
| Migration ID mismatch | 2026_06_02 migration uses UNSIGNED INT for FK columns while baseline uses signed INT -- MariaDB FK rejection blocked table creation |

### Migration gap summary

| Migration File | Tables Added | Status |
|---------------|--------------|--------|
| 2026_04_27_penalty_system.sql | penalties, penalty_assessments | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_05_29_employee_center.sql | employees, shifts | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_05_29_phase12_automation.sql | workflows | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_06_02_release_governance.sql | release_drafts, release_versions, release_approvals, release_schedule | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_06_04_obligation_registry.sql | obligations, obligation_payments, obligation_tasks | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_06_10_duplicate_control.sql | duplicate_task_flags, duplicate_bill_flags | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_06_15_remember_tokens.sql | remember_tokens | NEVER RUN |
| 2026_06_02_p0_task_detail_schema_sync.sql | 20 columns on tasks | NEVER RUN (partial via fix_schema.php) |

## 7. RECOMMENDATIONS

### Immediate (BLOCKER)

1. **Apply all pending migrations to production DB** -- SSH to DreamHost and run: php migrate.php
2. **Fix FK column type mismatch** -- ALTER UNSIGNED INT columns to signed INT (or drop and recreate the affected tables)
3. **Re-run verify-schema.php** -- Confirm 0 failures before resuming certification
4. **Re-run Mobile Production Certification** -- All P0 mobile bugs were symptoms of schema drift, not code bugs

### Short-term

5. **Add schema gate to deploy.php** -- Run php scripts/verify-schema.php after git reset, block deploy on FAIL
6. **Add pre-push hook** -- Run verify-schema.php in .git/hooks/pre-push to catch drift before deploy
7. **Commit fix_schema.php as a temporary tool** -- Until migrate.php works end-to-end, fix_schema.php is the only path

### Long-term

8. **Implement migration runner in CI/CD** -- Automate schema verification and migration on every deploy
9. **Add schema version tracking** -- Store a schema_version row in a metadata table and compare on boot
10. **Remove fix_schema.php** -- One-shot tools should be retired once proper migration pipeline works
